															RRB Section Controller CEN No. 03/2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

															Computer Based Test (CBT)

															
																
																Total Duration: 120 minutes.
																
																
																Total Questions: 100 objective-type questions with multiple choices.
																
																
																Negative Marking: There will be negative marking, with a penalty of 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer.
																
																
																Normalization: The CBT will be held in multiple shifts, and a normalized score will be used for shortlisting candidates for the CBAT.
																
															

															CBT Syllabus

															The syllabus for the CBT is divided into three sections:

															
																
																Analytical and Mathematical Capability:

																
																	
																	Mathematics: Includes topics like Averages, Percentages, Profit, Loss & Discounts, Time, Speed, Distance, Power & Work, Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM, HCF, Geometry, Area & Volumes, Probability & Statistics (both basic level).
																	
																	
																	Data Analysis & Interpretation: Includes Multi-source Data Analysis, Examination, analysis and Inference drawing from text, tabular data and data represented graphically (charts, graphs, scatter plot, pie chart, statistical curve distribution, Venn Diagrams), Data Sufficiency, and Data Arrangement.
																	
																
																
																
																Logical Capability:

																
																	
																	Logical Reasoning: Includes Binary Logic, Syllogism, Clocks & Calendars, Assumptions, Blood Relations, Family Tree, and Solving logic-based puzzles.
																	
																	
																	Reading Comprehension: Passages would be given from subjects like History, Society, Literature, Science, Environment, Abstract, Mythology, Technology and Culture. Candidates will need to understand the main idea, supporting idea, application, logical structure, and style of the passage to answer questions.
																	
																
																
																
																Mental Reasoning:

																
																	
																	Analogy: Identifying the relationship between two terms and applying it to another pair.
																	
																	
																	Series Completion: Identifying the pattern in a sequence of numbers and predicting the next term.
																	
																	
																	Solving Coding-Decoding type questions, Solving Ranking and Arrangements based problems.
																	
																
																
															

															
															Section-Wise Question Distribution (Indicative)

															
																
																Analytical and Mathematical Capability: 60 questions
																
																
																Logical Capability: 20 questions
																
																
																Mental Reasoning: 20 questions
																
																
																Total: 100 questions
																
															
															

															Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)

															
																
																Shortlisting: Candidates equal to 8 times the number of vacancies will be selected for the CBAT.
																
																
																Qualifying Marks: Candidates must secure a minimum T-Score of 42 in each of the test batteries to qualify. This applies to all candidates, regardless of community or category.
																
																
																Exam Type: This test contains questions and answer options only in English and Hindi.
																
																
																Negative Marking: There will be no negative marking in the CBAT.

															RRB Section Controller CEN No. 03/2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

															Computer Based Test (CBT)

															
																
																Total Duration: 120 minutes.
																
																
																Total Questions: 100 objective-type questions with multiple choices.
																
																
																Negative Marking: There will be negative marking, with a penalty of 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer.
																
																
																Normalization: The CBT will be held in multiple shifts, and a normalized score will be used for shortlisting candidates for the CBAT.
																
															

															CBT Syllabus

															The syllabus for the CBT is divided into three sections:

															
																
																Analytical and Mathematical Capability:

																
																	
																	Mathematics: Includes topics like Averages, Percentages, Profit, Loss & Discounts, Time, Speed, Distance, Power & Work, Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM, HCF, Geometry, Area & Volumes, Probability & Statistics (both basic level).
																	
																	
																	Data Analysis & Interpretation: Includes Multi-source Data Analysis, Examination, analysis and Inference drawing from text, tabular data and data represented graphically (charts, graphs, scatter plot, pie chart, statistical curve distribution, Venn Diagrams), Data Sufficiency, and Data Arrangement.
																	
																
																
																
																Logical Capability:

																
																	
																	Logical Reasoning: Includes Binary Logic, Syllogism, Clocks & Calendars, Assumptions, Blood Relations, Family Tree, and Solving logic-based puzzles.
																	
																	
																	Reading Comprehension: Passages would be given from subjects like History, Society, Literature, Science, Environment, Abstract, Mythology, Technology and Culture. Candidates will need to understand the main idea, supporting idea, application, logical structure, and style of the passage to answer questions.
																	
																
																
																
																Mental Reasoning:

																
																	
																	Analogy: Identifying the relationship between two terms and applying it to another pair.
																	
																	
																	Series Completion: Identifying the pattern in a sequence of numbers and predicting the next term.
																	
																	
																	Solving Coding-Decoding type questions, Solving Ranking and Arrangements based problems.
																	
																
																
															

															
															Section-Wise Question Distribution (Indicative)

															
																
																Analytical and Mathematical Capability: 60 questions
																
																
																Logical Capability: 20 questions
																
																
																Mental Reasoning: 20 questions
																
																
																Total: 100 questions
																
															
															

															Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)

															
																
																Shortlisting: Candidates equal to 8 times the number of vacancies will be selected for the CBAT.
																
																
																Qualifying Marks: Candidates must secure a minimum T-Score of 42 in each of the test batteries to qualify. This applies to all candidates, regardless of community or category.
																
																
																Exam Type: This test contains questions and answer options only in English and Hindi.
																
																
																Negative Marking: There will be no negative marking in the CBAT.
																
																
																Merit List: The merit list will be drawn based on the candidates' performance in both the CBT (70% weightage) and the CBAT (30% weightage).
																
															

															Document Verification (DV)

															
																
																Candidates will be called for document verification based on the merit list prepared using a 70% weightage for marks obtained in CBT and a 30% weightage for marks obtained in CBAT.
																
																
																In case of a tie in marks, the merit position will be determined by age (the older person is placed higher) and then by the alphabetical order of the name.
																
															

															Minimum Qualifying Marks

															The minimum percentage of qualifying marks for the CBT is as follows:

															
																
																UR (Unreserved) & EWS (Economically Weaker Section): 40%
																
																
																OBC (Non-creamy layer): 30%
																
																
																SC (Scheduled Caste): 30%
																
																
																ST (Scheduled Tribe): 25%
																
															

															Note: The qualifying percentages for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) candidates are relaxed by 2 marks in case of a shortage of qualified candidates.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.
																			
																			
																			Minimum Category-wise Cut-off for Merit Eligibility:

																			
																				
																				General Category: 40%
																				
																				
																				Backward Class (BC): 36.5%
																				
																				
																				Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 34%
																				
																				
																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%
																				
																			
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Bihar Police Company Commander (BHG) 2026: Document Required at the Time of Online Application

																		
																			
																			Qualification Certificates (10th/ SSC/ Matriculation, Graduation & etc.).
																			
																			
																			Address (According to Aadhar/ Voter ID/ Driving License/ Passport/ Ration Card/ Birth Certificate ).
																			
																			
																			Scan Recent Passport Size Photo in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																			
																			Scan Signature in Hindi & English.. Both Signature Will be on White Paper with Black Ink in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

																		
																			Pay Scale:- Havildar Instructor-  ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400/-  (Level-6)

						About OFSS

						Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has developed an online system named Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS) which will enable the students to take admission in Intermediate courses of Arts/Science/Commerce/Agriculture/Vocational in different Colleges/Schools (Except Minority Institutions and Residential institutions) affiliated and recognised with Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) in all 38 districts in the state of Bihar.

						Who can apply?

						Students who have passed the matriculation or equivalent Examination from Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB), Central Board for Secondary Education (CBSE), Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE) or any other national / state boards are eligible to apply online for admission.

						Students can apply in on‐line Common Application Form (CAF) available on ofssbihar.net and can be accessed from any place where Internet facility is available. The application fee for the online admission is Rs. 350/‐ only and the mode of payment has been described in Common application form (CAF).

						This system makes the entire admission process transparent, reliable, hassle free and cost effective thereby reducing the anxiety of applicants/parents regarding the selection and related queries.

						
						
						
												

						OFSS Bihar 2026: Your Gateway to Intermediate Admission Made Easy

						The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has officially launched the OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026–2028 portal, streamlining the process for students to get into top government and recognized institutions across Bihar. Through the Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS), students who have passed Class 10 from BSEB, CBSE, ICSE, or any recognized board can now apply online for admission into Intermediate (Class 11) in Science, Commerce, Arts, or Agriculture streams. This user-friendly system allows applicants to fill a single Common Application Form (CAF) at www.ofssbihar.net, saving time and eliminating paperwork hassles.

						The application process is live from April 8, 2026, to April 25, 2026, and candidates can choose a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 20 institutions/subject groups based on preference. With an application fee of just ₹350, payable through debit/credit card, net banking, or HDFC e-challan, this platform is accessible and affordable for all. Students must upload a passport-sized photo and accurate marks from their matric exam. OFSS ensures full transparency—every application receives an Acknowledgment Copy for future reference.

						Additionally, free support is available at District Registration cum Counseling Centers (DRCCs) for students needing help with the process. The reservation policy as per Bihar Govt. guidelines ensures fair chances for SC, ST, BC, EBC, EWS, and women candidates.

						If you're dreaming of a bright academic future in Bihar, don’t miss this golden opportunity. Visit the official OFSS Bihar website, read the prospectus carefully, and complete your application before the deadline. For real-time updates and support, call the helpline at 0612-2230009.

						

						📝 OFSS Bihar 11th Admission 2026: Selection Process, Merit List & Spot Admission Details

						The Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS) Bihar is the official platform managed by the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) for admission into Class 11 (Intermediate) courses across various schools and colleges in Bihar. The OFSS Bihar 11th Admission 2026 process is now live, and here's a complete breakdown of how students can secure their seat based on merit, preferences, and cut-off lists.

						📌 Selection Process for OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026

						
						Once students submit their online application through the OFSS portal, the system automatically prepares the final selection list. This list is generated based on:

						
							Merit (Class 10th marks)
							College and stream preferences selected in the Common Application Form (CAF)
						

						If a student's name appears in the merit list for their preferred college, they can proceed with the admission process as outlined below.

						✅ What to Do After Selection?

						
							Download Intimation Letter: Visit https://www.ofssbihar.net to download the letter.
							Report to Allotted College: Visit the college on the mentioned date with original documents and admission fees.
							Document Verification: Carry passport-size photos, Class 10 marksheet, and ID proof for verification.
							Seek College Info: For queries, students can directly contact their allotted colleges.
						

						📋 Merit List, Cut-Off & Slide-Up Process

						🔹 OFSS Bihar Merit List 2026

						The merit list is published in phases — 1st, 2nd, and 3rd rounds. After each release, students can:

						
							Check their name in the list
							Download the Intimation Letter
							Take admission in the respective college
						

						🔁 Slide-Up Option

						If you are not satisfied with your allotted college in the merit list, use the Slide-Up option to wait for a better allocation in the next round. It gives students a second chance to get into their preferred college.

						🎯 OFSS Bihar Spot Admission 2026

						After all merit lists are declared, students who are still unadmitted can participate in Spot Admission. In this round:

						
							Download the Intimation Letter again
							Approach any college with vacant seats directly for admission

						FAQs – OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026–28

						1. What is OFSS Bihar?
						OFSS (Online Facilitation System for Students) is an online platform by Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) for Intermediate (Class 11) admissions in government and recognized schools/colleges across Bihar.

						2. Who can apply for OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026–28?
						Students who have passed the Matric/10th exam from Bihar Board, CBSE, ICSE, or any other recognized board are eligible to apply.

						3. What is the official website to apply?
						You can apply at the official OFSS portal: https://ofssbihar.net

						4. What is the application date for OFSS 2026?
						The online application starts on April 8, 2026 and ends on April 25, 2026.

						5. How much is the application fee?
						The application fee is ₹350, payable via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or HDFC Bank e-Challan.

						6. How many colleges or subject groups can I choose?
						You can select a minimum of 1 and maximum of 20 institutions/subject groups in order of preference.

						7. Is there any offline method to apply?
						No. Applications are accepted only through online mode via the OFSS website.

						8. Can I modify my application after submission?
						You can only modify your application before final submission. Once submitted and paid, changes are not allowed.

						9. Where can I get help filling out the form?
						You can visit your district’s DRCC (District Registration cum Counselling Center) for free assistance.

						10. What is the helpline number for support?
						For queries, call the OFSS helpline: 0612-2230009 (Available on working days, 10 AM to 5 PM).

						About OFSS

						Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has developed an online system named Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS) which will enable the students to take admission in Intermediate courses of Arts/Science/Commerce/Agriculture/Vocational in different Colleges/Schools (Except Minority Institutions and Residential institutions) affiliated and recognised with Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) in all 38 districts in the state of Bihar.

						Who can apply?

						Students who have passed the matriculation or equivalent Examination from Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB), Central Board for Secondary Education (CBSE), Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE) or any other national / state boards are eligible to apply online for admission.

						Students can apply in on‐line Common Application Form (CAF) available on ofssbihar.net and can be accessed from any place where Internet facility is available. The application fee for the online admission is Rs. 350/‐ only and the mode of payment has been described in Common application form (CAF).

						This system makes the entire admission process transparent, reliable, hassle free and cost effective thereby reducing the anxiety of applicants/parents regarding the selection and related queries.

						
						
						
												

						OFSS Bihar 2026: Your Gateway to Intermediate Admission Made Easy

						The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has officially launched the OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026–2028 portal, streamlining the process for students to get into top government and recognized institutions across Bihar. Through the Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS), students who have passed Class 10 from BSEB, CBSE, ICSE, or any recognized board can now apply online for admission into Intermediate (Class 11) in Science, Commerce, Arts, or Agriculture streams. This user-friendly system allows applicants to fill a single Common Application Form (CAF) at www.ofssbihar.net, saving time and eliminating paperwork hassles.

						The application process is live from April 8, 2026, to April 25, 2026, and candidates can choose a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 20 institutions/subject groups based on preference. With an application fee of just ₹350, payable through debit/credit card, net banking, or HDFC e-challan, this platform is accessible and affordable for all. Students must upload a passport-sized photo and accurate marks from their matric exam. OFSS ensures full transparency—every application receives an Acknowledgment Copy for future reference.

						Additionally, free support is available at District Registration cum Counseling Centers (DRCCs) for students needing help with the process. The reservation policy as per Bihar Govt. guidelines ensures fair chances for SC, ST, BC, EBC, EWS, and women candidates.

						If you're dreaming of a bright academic future in Bihar, don’t miss this golden opportunity. Visit the official OFSS Bihar website, read the prospectus carefully, and complete your application before the deadline. For real-time updates and support, call the helpline at 0612-2230009.

						

						📝 OFSS Bihar 11th Admission 2026: Selection Process, Merit List & Spot Admission Details

						The Online Facilitation System for Students (OFSS) Bihar is the official platform managed by the Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) for admission into Class 11 (Intermediate) courses across various schools and colleges in Bihar. The OFSS Bihar 11th Admission 2026 process is now live, and here's a complete breakdown of how students can secure their seat based on merit, preferences, and cut-off lists.

						📌 Selection Process for OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026

						
						Once students submit their online application through the OFSS portal, the system automatically prepares the final selection list. This list is generated based on:

						
							Merit (Class 10th marks)
							College and stream preferences selected in the Common Application Form (CAF)
						

						If a student's name appears in the merit list for their preferred college, they can proceed with the admission process as outlined below.

						✅ What to Do After Selection?

						
							Download Intimation Letter: Visit https://www.ofssbihar.net to download the letter.
							Report to Allotted College: Visit the college on the mentioned date with original documents and admission fees.
							Document Verification: Carry passport-size photos, Class 10 marksheet, and ID proof for verification.
							Seek College Info: For queries, students can directly contact their allotted colleges.
						

						📋 Merit List, Cut-Off & Slide-Up Process

						🔹 OFSS Bihar Merit List 2026

						The merit list is published in phases — 1st, 2nd, and 3rd rounds. After each release, students can:

						
							Check their name in the list
							Download the Intimation Letter
							Take admission in the respective college
						

						🔁 Slide-Up Option

						If you are not satisfied with your allotted college in the merit list, use the Slide-Up option to wait for a better allocation in the next round. It gives students a second chance to get into their preferred college.

						🎯 OFSS Bihar Spot Admission 2026

						After all merit lists are declared, students who are still unadmitted can participate in Spot Admission. In this round:

						
							Download the Intimation Letter again
							Approach any college with vacant seats directly for admission

							Go to https://ofssbihar.net
							Click on “Click Here to Download Your Intimation Letter”
							Enter Application Reference No. / Barcode, Mobile No., and Captcha
							Click Print to download
						
						 

						

						

						

						FAQs – OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026–28

						1. What is OFSS Bihar?
						OFSS (Online Facilitation System for Students) is an online platform by Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) for Intermediate (Class 11) admissions in government and recognized schools/colleges across Bihar.

						2. Who can apply for OFSS Bihar Intermediate Admission 2026–28?
						Students who have passed the Matric/10th exam from Bihar Board, CBSE, ICSE, or any other recognized board are eligible to apply.

						3. What is the official website to apply?
						You can apply at the official OFSS portal: https://ofssbihar.net

						4. What is the application date for OFSS 2026?
						The online application starts on April 8, 2026 and ends on April 25, 2026.

						5. How much is the application fee?
						The application fee is ₹350, payable via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or HDFC Bank e-Challan.

						6. How many colleges or subject groups can I choose?
						You can select a minimum of 1 and maximum of 20 institutions/subject groups in order of preference.

						7. Is there any offline method to apply?
						No. Applications are accepted only through online mode via the OFSS website.

						8. Can I modify my application after submission?
						You can only modify your application before final submission. Once submitted and paid, changes are not allowed.

						9. Where can I get help filling out the form?
						You can visit your district’s DRCC (District Registration cum Counselling Center) for free assistance.

						10. What is the helpline number for support?
						For queries, call the OFSS helpline: 0612-2230009 (Available on working days, 10 AM to 5 PM).
